The '''atomic engine''' was a type of [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheric]] propulsion [[Engine/Legends|engine]] that was used as a power source in primitive vehicles. [[Repulsorlift/Legends|Repulsorlift]] engine manufacturers claimed that the advent of repulsorlift effectively rendered other engine types obsolete, including the atomic engine. However, atomic engines were still in use on less-developed [[Planet/Legends|worlds]].<ref name="SWS">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''</ref>
